## Will it actually work?

The engineering is clean (character‑offset alignment in [core.py](logit_bridge/core.py), chunked sparse projection in [projection.py](logit_bridge/projection.py)), and it will *run* without shape errors. But three issues stand between "runs" and "actually transfers knowledge":

You'd want to pretrain/anchor the adapter (e.g., fit it to the embedding‑similarity matrix first, or supervise it on shared exact‑match tokens) and then freeze or heavily regularize it.

Without something like Procrustes alignment on the ~tens of thousands of byte‑identical shared tokens, the zero‑shot top‑k map will be noisy.
